Your completion choices are stored in this browser under a versioned curriculum
schema. FreeCampus Math stores no name, raw answer, detailed attempt history, or
behavioral analytics. Clearing site data removes the record.

<div class="progress-dashboard" data-progress-summary="pathway" aria-live="polite">
  <p>Progress will appear when JavaScript is available.</p>
</div>

## Manage your local record

<div class="progress-actions">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-progress-action="export">Export progress</button>
  <label class="btn btn-secondary" for="progress-import">Import progress</label>
  <input id="progress-import" type="file" accept="application/json" data-progress-action="import" hidden>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger" data-progress-action="reset">Reset progress</button>
</div>

<div class="visually-hidden" role="status" data-progress-announcement></div>

::: {.callout-note}
Completion is a study bookmark, not proof of mastery. Use diagnostic and
cumulative assessments to decide what to review.
:::
